health_benefits: Rich in alpha-tocopherol (Vitamin E), magnesium, and monounsaturated fats; lowers LDL cholesterol, regulates blood sugar, and enhances skin health.
intake_methods: Soak 5-6 almonds overnight, peel and eat in the morning; or consume raw/dry-roasted as a midday snack.

health_benefits: High-density plant protein, resveratrol, and niacin (B3); supports muscle synthesis, heart health, and sustained satiety.
intake_methods: Boiled, dry-roasted without salt, prepared as natural peanut butter, or added to traditional sundal and poha.

health_benefits: Abundant in copper, magnesium, and oleic acid; promotes red blood cell formation, supports bone integrity, and protects eye tissue.
intake_methods: Eat a small handful raw or lightly toasted, blend into dairy-free curry gravies, or mix into trail mixes.

health_benefits: Outstanding dietary source of plant Omega-3 fatty acids (ALA) and polyphenols; boosts cognitive health, reduces arterial inflammation, and supports heart function.
intake_methods: Eat 2-3 soaked walnut halves on an empty stomach in the morning, crush over salads, or blend into morning smoothies.

health_benefits: Packed with lutein, zeaxanthin, Vitamin B6, and amino acids; supports ocular health, endothelial blood flow, and blood glucose control.
intake_methods: Consume unsalted roasted pistachios as a portion-controlled snack, or chop over oats and yogurt bowls.

health_benefits: Potent concentration of Vitamin E, selenium, and phytosterols; shields cells against free radical oxidation, regulates cholesterol, and supports thyroid function.
intake_methods: Lightly dry-roast and sprinkle over green salads, mix into multigrain bread dough, or add to homemade granola.

health_benefits: Remarkable source of bioavailable zinc, magnesium, and tryptophan; supports prostate/bladder health, enhances testosterone synthesis, and improves restful sleep.
intake_methods: Consume 1 tablespoon dry-roasted seeds with spices, sprinkle over vegetable soups, or blend into energy bars.

health_benefits: Highest plant-based source of lignans (phytoestrogens), alpha-linolenic acid (ALA), and soluble mucilage fiber; aids hormonal balance, relieves constipation, and reduces blood pressure.
intake_methods: Grind into fresh flaxseed powder (whole seeds pass undigested) and mix 1 tablespoon into warm water, rotis, curd, or smoothies.

health_benefits: Massive hydrophilic soluble fiber and Omega-3 content; forms a soothing digestive gel, regulates glycemic spikes, supports prolonged hydration, and strengthens bone density.
intake_methods: Soak 1-2 teaspoons in water or milk for 15-20 minutes until gelled; use in chia puddings, detox lemon water, or fruit smoothies.

health_benefits: Extraordinarily rich in non-dairy calcium, sesamin, and sesamolin; builds peak bone mineral density, supports joint lubrication, and assists blood pressure regulation.
intake_methods: Dry-roast and use in sesame chikki/ellu urundai, sprinkle over stir-fried dishes, make tahini paste, or blend into idli podi.
